chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Umar or someone else, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The performer of the Umra performs Tawaf, then Sa'ee, then shaves (his head). He (peace be upon him) said: And it is necessary for him, after the shaving, to perform another Tawaf.

key_terms.يَسْعَى: Performs Sa'ee (walking between Safa and Marwa)

ai.seo_question: What is the required sequence of rituals for Umra according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the ritual sequence of Umra, specifically highlighting the necessity of a second Tawaf (Tawaf al-Nisa) after the initial shaving or cutting of hair, a practice rooted in Shia fiqh to complete the pilgrimage rites. It underscores the precision required in Hajj and Umra rituals, linking the physical act of purification (Haly) with the spiritual completion of the circumambulation.
